name: ProfileCard-TS-TW
title: Profile Card
description: A tall portrait card with a tinted headshot, a large name and a glassy footer bar holding a handle, status and contact button. Moving the pointer tilts it and drags a colourful glare across the surface.
use: You want a memorable team or profile card whose tilt and sheen invite the pointer on a landing page.
avoid: Tilt needs a pointing device, so touch gets a flat card, and a missing avatar leaves only the gradient shell.
a11y: The 3D tilt and sheen loop ignore reduced-motion, and the job title is drawn over the portrait where it is hard to read. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall portrait card with rounded corners holding a colour-tinted headshot that fills it. A big white-to-violet name sits over the photo with a faint job title beneath, and a translucent bar across the bottom holds a round avatar, handle, status and an outlined button. A blue-purple gradient covers the surface.
behaves: Moving the pointer across the card tilts it in 3D and carries a glossy glare and rainbow sheen along with it; on leave it eases back flat. A short settle animation plays as it mounts, and a slow sheen loop runs continuously.
customise: Pass the name, title, handle, status, contact text and avatar images as props; tilt, mobile tilt, the behind glow and inner gradient are toggles. Colours, radius and layout are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One card and one pointer-tracking RAF loop that stops when settled, plus a slow CSS sheen keyframe.
demo: Name Daniel Okafor, title Design Engineer, handle @danokafor, status Online, and the button reads Contact Me.
issues: The job title overlaps the name and portrait, so it is barely legible.
The shine and glare layers animate in a continuous loop, so the card never fully rests.
polishWhy: Convincing holographic glare and tilt, but the job title collides with the name and photo.
